predictionHistoryDetail.title: Analysis Report
predictionHistoryDetail.clinicalIndicators: Based on the provided clinical indicators.

charts.shapWaterfallDescription: Visualizes how individual factors shift the prediction from the baseline.
charts.shapWaterfallMiddle: indicate factors increasing heart failure risk,
charts.shapBarDescription: Ranks health indicators by their absolute impact on the prediction. Longer bars indicate features that contributed most strongly to the model's decision for this patient.
charts.limeDescription: Shows local feature impacts by analyzing the specific data ranges that influenced this exact prediction.

glossary.chestPainType: TA: Typical Angina, ATA: Atypical Angina, NAP: Non-Anginal Pain, ASY: Asymptomatic.
glossary.fastingBs: Fasting blood sugar. 1 if > 120 mg/dl, 0 otherwise.
glossary.restingEcg: Resting electrocardiogram results: Normal, ST: ST-T wave abnormality, LVH: Left ventricular hypertrophy.
glossary.oldpeak: ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest.
glossary.stSlope: The slope of the peak exercise ST segment: Up, Flat, Down.

xai.title: Batch explainability analysis
xai.shapBarDesc: Displays the global importance of each feature across all patients. Longer bars indicate features that had the most significant impact on the model's overall predictions.
xai.shapBeeswarmDesc1: Visualizes how feature values across all patients influence the model's output. Each dot represents a single patient; its horizontal position indicates whether it increases (right) or decreases (left) the prediction risk. Color represents the feature value:

charts.shapWaterfallDesc: Visualizes how individual factors shift the prediction from the baseline. Red bars indicate factors increasing risk, while blue bars indicate factors decreasing risk.
charts.shapBarDesc: Ranks health indicators by their absolute impact on the prediction. Longer bars indicate features that contributed most strongly to the model's decision for this patient.
charts.limeDesc: Shows local feature impacts by analyzing the specific data ranges that influenced this exact prediction.
